rule_note: Access from abroad or with a foreign number, reported as a failure or block -> D2. A bare question about using the app abroad, with no failure stated -> N5.
Transaction failed, stuck or money missing -> D1 (no network mention needed). D4 = flow design: confirmation, mis-send, undo, too many steps.
Opening or verifying a NEW account -> D5. Getting into an EXISTING account (login, OTP, PIN) -> D2.
Forced/frequent updates or breakage tied to an update -> D8. Control of settings, preferences or notifications; hard-to-find features -> D11.
Operator recharge or outside-service failure -> D12. Breakage the reviewer ties to an update or OS change -> D8.
Finding or controlling a feature, setting or subscription inside the app -> D11. Failure, limit or missing integration with an outside bank, card, wallet or operator -> D12.
Bug inside login/OTP/PIN -> D2 (code the flow it breaks). D7 only when a feature fails, or the app can't run on the phone, and no flow code covers it.
